claims.statement: The incident affects 186 orders with quantified customer impact established through the impact_estimate artifact.
claims.corroboration: Count of stranded orders and impact duration documented in the impact_estimate artifact released after count_stranded_orders diagnostic.
claims.limitation: Impact is scoped to the identified 186 orders held in EXC-0921 cohort; no additional impact from collateral systems identified.

next_action.rationale: All blocking requirements met: root cause established (C6: transient carrier feed lag on east-node lanes with 47-minute booking-to-confirmation lag vs. 30-minute slot window); discriminating evidence provided (m8_r_handoffs, m8_r_exceptions); customer impact quantified (m8_r_impact); no open contradictions. v18 allocation rule change is not itself defective. Mitigation strategy identified: apply slot correction to the affected east-node carrier feed (identity pending from m8_r_owner confirmation), then replay held allocations. First mitigation attempt was misdirected; Carrier Operations has confirmed the correction approach is reversible and safe.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Closure of the incident assessment with documented root cause, established impact, and approved reversible mitigation strategy.
